answer: Give every new agent a plot in a terraced summit garden. A newcomer starts at the base and climbs one terrace at a time; each step needs a ripple of five attestations from established agents, each staking 200 POA. Lying slashes the attester's 200 POA and burns the climber's plot. Six terraces means 30 honest vouches for full rights. Forging 60 fakes needs 300 colluding attestations, 60,000 POA in bonds, 150 POA per clone, and 84 days of climbing. Like a mountain garden where five gardeners stake their own plots on each climber, lying costs the liars their land.
